fact: The BCEAO says Treasuries connected to PI-SPI can receive taxes and duties from any account, and Cote d'Ivoire's Treasury has met all PI-SPI requirements.

Clotchor Secongo says his digital solutions, including the Treasury's TresorPay e-payment platform, have improved some municipal revenues in 75 local authorities in Cote d'Ivoire; the source is his own note to the newspaper.
The finance ministry says online filing and online payment of taxes and duties (télé-déclaration, télépaiement) have been in operation in Côte d'Ivoire since 2017.
Minister Adama Coulibaly says collections via TresorPay reached FCFA 36 billion from 2.5 million transactions in 2024.
Minister Adama Coulibaly gives collections via TresorPay as FCFA 3 billion in 2021 and FCFA 36 billion in 2024.
